rustMapping.reason: every pinned stream cipher plus every protocol plugin (origin, auth_sha1_v4, auth_aes128_md5, auth_aes128_sha1, auth_chain_a, auth_chain_b), every obfs plugin (plain, http_simple, http_post, random_head, tls1.2_ticket_auth, tls1.2_ticket_fastauth) and the UDP association.
